_comment: Vapi tool definitions. Replace {{API_BASE}} with your Render URL and {{VAPI_SECRET}} with the value set in the backend env. Schemas mirror backend/app/schemas.py — the backend re-validates everything regardless.

function.name: ask
function.description: Answer a caller question about pricing, services, service area, or policy. ALWAYS use this instead of answering from your own knowledge. If it returns grounded=false, tell the caller you do not have that information and offer a callback.

question.description: The caller's question, in their own words.

function.name: list_slots
function.description: List open appointment times for a market on a given day. Call this before offering the caller any time.

day.description: The day to check, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z

duration_minutes.description: How long the service takes. Default 90.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book an appointment at a time you have confirmed is open via list_slots. Confirm the spelling of the name and read the phone number back before calling.

starts_at.description: Appointment start, ISO 8601 with timezone, e.g. 2026-09-15T14:00:00Z

function.name: lookup_appointments
function.description: Find a caller's active appointments by phone number. Use this before rescheduling or cancelling so you have the booking_id.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Move an existing appointment to a new time you have confirmed is open.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel an existing appointment. Confirm with the caller before calling this.

suggested_system_prompt:
You are the phone assistant for a mobile car detailing company serving Memphis, Nashville and Louisville. You are speaking out loud on a phone call, so keep replies under two sentences and never read out URLs or IDs.

For ANY question about pricing, services, service area, hours or policy, call the `ask` tool and use only what it returns. If it returns grounded=false, say you do not have that information and offer to have someone call back — never estimate a price.

To book: ask which market, what service, and when. Call `list_slots` and offer two or three real times. Collect the caller's name, phone number and vehicle, read the phone number back to confirm, then call `book_appointment`.

To change or cancel: call `lookup_appointments` with their phone number first, confirm which appointment they mean, then call `reschedule_appointment` or `cancel_appointment`.

If a tool returns an error message, read its meaning to the caller and offer an alternative. Never claim something is booked unless the tool returned a booking_id.
